_nota: Propuesta inglesa para los términos NORMATIVOS de comun/glosario.md. El español de esos términos está fijado allí y no se toca; lo que este archivo añade es el inglés, que es PROPUESTA del traductor y no está adjudicado por el IEBH. La clave es el lema pāḷi tal como aparece en la tabla de comun/glosario.md, sin cursivas. Donde el glosario español no fija un término pāḷi sino un castellano (la entrada «—» de 'secuencia'), la clave es ese castellano entre corchetes.

ingles.bhāvakamma: (in) the impersonal and the passive voice
ingles.tija-gupa-kita-māna: the roots tija, gupa, kita and māna

ingles.-ggahaṇa (caggahaṇa, vāggahaṇa): the mention of «ca» / «vā» (in the sutta); «by the mention of ca…»

ingles.bahuvacananiddesa: plural statement (in the sutta, to cover more than one case)
ingles.āsīsana: wishing; blessing (a use of the imperative)
ingles.tappakativacana: expression of «made of that» (sense of the suffix 'maya')
ingles.jha-saññā: the designation «jha» (masculine and neuter bases ending in 'i', 'ī')
ingles.la-saññā: the designation «la» (masculine and neuter bases ending in ‘u’ ‘ū’)
ingles.saṅketa: conventional marker (a letter of the sutta that is not part of the form)
ingles.pañcamī: imperative (not translated in the body; not the nominal fifth inflection)
ingles.sattamī: potential (not translated in the body; not the nominal seventh inflection)
ingles.parokkhā: not translated: past not directly perceived
ingles.ajjatanī: not translated: proximate past, beginning today
ingles.kālātipatti: not translated: action that has passed without happening
ingles.tulyādhikaraṇa: «referring to the same thing» (§324); «the same location» (§328); «the same locus» (§330–§332)
ingles.tulyādhikaraṇabahubbīhi / bhinnādhikaraṇ: relative compound having / not having the same location
ingles.bhāsitapuma: that indicated the masculine [in the past]
ingles.ṭhāna: according to context: «cause» (taddhita sense) or «(appropriate) place»
ingles.nipātana: not translated: direct formation by the catch-all sutta
ingles.apādāna: case of the point of departure
ingles.abhihita: expressed (by the verb, a kita, a taddhita or a compound)
ingles.icchitakamma / anicchitakamma / nevicchi: desired object / undesired object / object neither desired nor undesired
ingles.nipphattanīya / vikaraṇīya / pāpanīya: what is to be produced / modified / reached
ingles.pariccattakāraṇa / apariccattakāraṇa: with the cause abandoned / with the cause not abandoned
ingles.sadda-samasana / attha-samasana: grouping of words / grouping of meaning
ingles.pubbapadatthappadhāna / uttarapadatthapp: with predominance of the meaning of the first member / of the last / of both / of another word
ingles.nicca-samāsa / anicca-samāsa: obligatory compound («always compound», Nandisena) / facultative compound
ingles.kitanta-samāsa: compound whose last member is a primary derivative
ingles.asapada-viggaha (assapada-viggaha): resolution with another word (not a member of the compound)
ingles.pavattinimitta: reason for the application (of a word)
ingles.sambhāvanāpubbapada: (adjectival compound) whose first member expresses what is considered or attributed
ingles.ayuttatthasamāsa: compound whose members are not linked in meaning
ingles.samāhāra-digu / asamāhāra-digu: collective numerical compound / individual numerical compound
ingles.alopa-tappurisa / alutta-tappurisa: determinative compound without elision [of the inflection]
ingles.abhidheyya: denoted meaning (what is denoted by the compound)
ingles.vutti: compound or derived form (as opposed to vākya, the sentence)

_nota_anukaddhana: Los nombres ingleses de las funciones de «ca» —dragging, collecting, accumulating, delimiting, smoothness of speech— son los del Venerable Nandisena, tomados de su apéndice (docs/fuentes/nandisena-apendice-sandhi-en.md) y no propuesta nuestra.
_nota_particulas: kvaci / vā / navā = sometimes / optionally / occasionally está ya fijado en la edición inglesa del capítulo de Sandhi (comun/terminologia-particulas.md y docs/ingles/memo-sandhi-en-glosario-y-desviaciones.md §2).
